page.layout: One printed page, left part of a two-column text page: main column of text at centre-left with a narrow column of notes at the left margin of the column; a second column of text at the right edge (partly cut off). Running head at top. The main column contains a centred block of inscription lines and small-capital inscription lines; below, centred headings Aedes and Aedicula.; One column of text at the right edge, set as marginal-style entries in a narrow column; a ragged column of small entries running from the top to the bottom of the scan. Page number, running head and catchword not visible.
